card.name: Punctuation before renewable energy terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (colons, commas, 'of', 'from', 'as', list numbers) right before a renewable-energy term is expected, in text about green power, biomass or clean electricity.

modes.label: List openers
modes.description: Colon, parenthesis or comma in a list of renewable energy options.
modes.example: different product options<<:>> (1) Renewable Energy Certificates,

modes.label: Linking words before renewables
modes.description: 'from', 'as' or 'use' right before a renewable source is named.
modes.example: the state’s electricity is generated<< from>> renewable resources.

card.writes: It promotes 'Renew' and suppresses fossil, coal and mineral words, so it steers the next word toward renewable and away from fossil.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting marks just before the text names a renewable energy source rather than a fossil one.
